name: Bathroom Remodeling
summary: Complete bathroom remodeling with coordinated demolition, framing, plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, tile, vanities, countertops, fixtures, lighting, ventilation, drywall, paint and finish carpentry.
features: Tile walls, floors, niches and benches

faqs.question: How long does a complete bathroom remodel usually take?
faqs.answer: The schedule depends on demolition, hidden repairs, plumbing or electrical changes, inspections, waterproofing cure times, tile layout, glass fabrication and material availability. A detailed scope and material plan should be established before construction begins.

faqs.question: Can you convert a bathtub into a walk-in shower?
faqs.answer: Yes. A tub-to-shower conversion can include demolition, drain and supply-line adjustments, slope preparation, waterproofing, tile, niches, benches, grab-blocking, fixtures and a framed or frameless glass enclosure.

faqs.question: What waterproofing work is included in a custom tile shower?
faqs.answer: The system may include substrate preparation, a shower pan or bonded membrane, sealed corners and penetrations, curb or curbless detailing, flood testing when appropriate, and tile installation over the approved waterproof assembly.

faqs.question: Can the bathroom layout or plumbing locations be changed?
faqs.answer: Yes, when site conditions allow. Moving a vanity, toilet, tub or shower may require opening walls or concrete, rerouting supply and drain lines, framing changes, permits and additional repair work.

faqs.question: Do you handle the complete bathroom project or only tile?
faqs.answer: Luna General Contractors can coordinate the complete remodel, including demolition, carpentry, plumbing, electrical, waterproofing, tile, glass, vanity installation, countertops, drywall, painting, trim and final finish work.
